content.title: Equitable Holdings (NYSE:EQH) Misses Q3 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Financial services company Equitable Holdings (NYSE:EQH) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 61.6% year on year to $1.45 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.48 per share was 8.5% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
